newsitem.title: USA: Court sets order about Grossman's shares.
newsitem.headline: Court sets order about Grossman's shares.

text.p: Grossman's Inc said on Thursday that the U.S. Bankruptcy Court arranged a procedure for investors to acquire large blocks of the company's stock or its unsecured claims.

Procedures would require written notice to the company when a person or group proposes to acquire more than an aggregate of 1.35 million shares or a total of $6 million of pre-petition unsecured claims, Grossman's said.
If the company objects during a 30 period after the notice, then court approval would be necessary for the shares or claims to be purchased, Grossman's said.
Grossman's said this move is necessary to protect its operating loss carryforwards of $300 million as of December 1996, which will be critical in its ability to reorganize.
A final hearing for the procedure has been set for June 17, 1997, Grossman's said.
